answer: Give every new agent a probationary harbor: it may transact only inside a small escrow vault where its first earnings are held until a quorum of established peers vouches for its work. Forging one identity is cheap, but forging a hundred means funding a hundred vaults and producing a hundred streams of verifiable work that peers must each attest — an oasis of fake activity evaporates the moment attestation requires real, checkable output. Honest newcomers graduate automatically once their vault clears, so the gate is effort, not permission.
